transcript: Speaker A: Sometimes I'm working with my hands full and I could use a little extra help. That's when I use Wispr Flow. No more fighting my baby for the keyboard. Wispr Flow is so easy to use, all I have to do is speak.
on_screen_text:
trying to work during motherhood is WILD
Wispr Flow
helping me work through the chaos a little easier

summary: A mother shares her struggle of working while holding her baby and demonstrates how Wispr Flow helps her. By using voice-to-text, she can easily type without needing her hands on the keyboard. The ad highlights the convenience and ease of use for busy parents.
